name: openclaw
description: Local stub that satisfies the openclaw peer dependency of @tencent-weixin/openclaw-weixin. It provides only the plugin-sdk utilities the Weixin protocol layer imports; nothing else, and it is never published. The version tracks the lowest openclaw the plugin declares support for (peer range >=2026.5.12), so a plain `npm ci` resolves; a prerelease suffix would fall outside that range.
